description: This PHP source file defines a custom exception class KeyHandlerException within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the Core Exception namespace. The class provides static methods to generate exceptions for specific key handling errors, such as key already existing, failing to create a key, key absence, and unreadability.

classes.name: KeyHandlerException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending PHP's base Exception, providing static factory methods for specific key handling error scenarios.

methods.name: keyAlreadyExists
methods.description: Returns an instance of KeyHandlerException indicating the key already exists.

methods.name: failedToCreateKey
methods.description: Returns an instance of KeyHandlerException indicating failure to create the key.

methods.name: keyDoesNotExist
methods.description: Returns an instance of KeyHandlerException indicating the key file does not exist.

methods.name: keyIsNotReadable
methods.description: Returns an instance of KeyHandlerException indicating the key is not readable.
